name: Mercenary Soul Dagger
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Soul Dagger (players/warlock/soul_dagger.sval, its mercenary-primary block). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): reach 50 (30). Its own cooldown 0.25 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Soul Dagger reaches 50 instead of 30; Soul Consumption as at level 6 (20 magical per second for 5 s, 5% health and 10% mana back).
